ex.en: These hardy plants can survive the freezing winters of the north.
ex.zh: 这些耐寒植物能在北方严寒的冬季存活。

words.note: hardy 指耐寒、能吃苦，常修饰 plants 或 a hardy breed。

ex.en: The village built a new plant to purify water from the river.
ex.zh: 村里建了新厂来净化河水。

words.note: purify 由 pure 加 -ify 构成，「使…变纯」，常搭配 water、air。

ex.en: The death toll from the earthquake rose to over two hundred.
ex.zh: 地震造成的死亡人数升至两百多人。

words.note: death toll 指伤亡人数，toll road 指收费公路，两个搭配都常见。

ex.en: There is a wide variation in temperature between day and night in the desert.
ex.zh: 沙漠中昼夜温差很大。

words.note: variation 常与 in 连用，如 a variation in price。

ex.en: She gave me moral support when I was preparing for the exam.
ex.zh: 我准备考试时她给了我精神上的支持。

words.note: moral support 是「精神支持」；表道德观时常用复数 morals。

ex.en: The officials were accused of trying to rig the election.
ex.zh: 这些官员被指控试图操纵选举。

words.note: rig 表操纵时多接 election、match；oil rig 指海上钻井平台。

ex.en: The referee ejected two players after the fight.
ex.zh: 打斗之后裁判罚下了两名球员。

words.note: eject 比 throw out 正式；弹出光盘、磁带也用 eject。

ex.en: The car was recalled because of a defect in the braking system.
ex.zh: 这辆车因刹车系统存在缺陷被召回。

words.note: defect 常接 in，指具体缺陷；作动词读 /dɪˈfekt/ 意为叛逃。

ex.en: The evidence only served to reinforce our doubts about the plan.
ex.zh: 这些证据只是加深了我们对计划的怀疑。

words.note: reinforce 是 re- 加 force，「再加力」；常搭 belief。

ex.en: He turned up in casual clothes, which made him stand out at the formal dinner.
ex.zh: 他穿着便装出现，在正式晚宴上很扎眼。

words.note: casual 与 formal 相对；casual worker 指临时工。

ex.en: Don't slack off now that the exam is only a week away.
ex.zh: 考试只剩一周了，别松懈。

words.note: slack off 指偷懒松懈；生意清淡说 business is slack。

ex.en: She wiped the rim of the glass before pouring the juice.
ex.zh: 倒果汁前她擦了擦杯口。

words.note: rim 指圆形物的边沿，如杯口、轮辋；Pacific Rim 指环太平洋地区。

ex.en: The police warned that anyone damaging private property would be punished.
ex.zh: 警方警告说，破坏私有财产者将受处罚。

words.note: 表「性质」时多用复数 properties，如 chemical properties。

ex.en: He ripped the letter into pieces and threw it away.
ex.zh: 他把信撕成碎片扔掉了。

words.note: rip 比 tear 更强调用力撕开；rip off 还有「敲竹杠」义。

ex.en: The outbreak of the disease forced the school to close for a month.
ex.zh: 疾病暴发迫使学校停课一个月。

words.note: outbreak 后接 of：the outbreak of war / disease。

ex.en: Some companies manipulate data to make their products look safer.
ex.zh: 一些公司操纵数据，让产品看起来更安全。

words.note: manipulate 源于「用手操作」，引申为操纵他人或数据。

ex.en: The two brothers look very similar but have very different personalities.
ex.zh: 这两兄弟长得很像，性格却大不相同。

words.note: similar 后接 to，不接 with；名词形式是 similarity。

ex.en: His account of the accident contradicts what the other witnesses said.
ex.zh: 他对事故的描述与其他证人的说法相矛盾。

words.note: contra-（相反）加 dict（说），即「说相反的话」。

ex.en: The melody of that old song has stayed with me for years.
ex.zh: 那首老歌的旋律我记了很多年。

words.note: melody 指可哼唱的旋律，偏音乐术语；口语常说 tune。

ex.en: In all likelihood, the meeting will be postponed until next week.
ex.zh: 会议很可能推迟到下周。

words.note: in all likelihood 意为「极可能」，比 probably 更书面。

ex.en: Thousands of fans converged on the stadium before the final.
ex.zh: 决赛前，成千上万的球迷汇聚到体育场。

words.note: converge 常接 on/upon，指向一处汇集；反义词是 diverge。

ex.en: The committee is composed of ten members from different departments.
ex.zh: 委员会由来自不同部门的十名成员组成。

words.note: be composed of = consist of；compose 也指使镇定。

ex.en: Her tastes in music are remarkably catholic, ranging from jazz to folk.
ex.zh: 她的音乐品味非常广泛，从爵士到民谣都喜欢。

words.note: 大写 Catholic 指天主教；小写 catholic 意为广泛、包罗万象。

ex.en: She is rather partial to sweet coffee in the morning.
ex.zh: 她早上相当偏爱甜咖啡。

words.note: be partial to sth 意为偏爱；作「不公」讲时近 biased。

ex.en: The government promised more financial aid to the flood victims.
ex.zh: 政府承诺向洪灾灾民提供更多经济援助。

words.note: first aid 指急救；aid 比 help 正式，多作不可数名词。

ex.en: The company is developing a supersonic jet for business travel.
ex.zh: 该公司正研发用于商务出行的超音速喷气机。

words.note: super-（超过）加 son（声音）再加 -ic，即超音速的。

ex.en: There is growing optimism about the country's economic future.
ex.zh: 人们对国家经济前景越来越乐观。

words.note: optimism 常与 about 连用；反义是 pessimism。

ex.en: She is confident of passing the driving test this time.
ex.zh: 她相信这次能通过驾照考试。

words.note: confident of sth 或接 that 从句；名词是 confidence。

ex.en: The old town has retained much of its original charm.
ex.zh: 这座古镇保留了许多原有的魅力。

words.note: retain 比 keep 正式，强调继续保有，如 retain control。

ex.en: The government took drastic measures to cut air pollution.
ex.zh: 政府采取严厉措施减少空气污染。

words.note: drastic 多修饰 measures、changes，含猛烈而带副作用的意味。
